hints.title: Find paths from the root
hints.body: The common ancestor is the last node shared by the paths to the two values.

hints.title: Parent links
hints.body: Record each node's parent during one traversal.

hints.title: Mark ancestors
hints.body: Walk from the first value to the root, then walk from the second until a marked node is reached.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
parents = {root.value: null}
visit every node and record parent[child] = node
seen = empty set
value = first
while value is not null:
    seen.add(value)
    value = parents[value]
value = second
while value not in seen:
    value = parents[value]
return value
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
